execution.signal: Original index.html engine, daily completed close; no parameter or rule changes
execution.timing: First ETF trade of a later index session; never signal-day execution
execution.buyMissingOrLimit: Defer until tradable, cancel at close if its own exit is signalled first
execution.sellMissingOrLimit: Defer; keep its first exit reason and do not replace it using future signals
execution.priority: Sell first, then initial/correction entries in stable original entry order
execution.minimumCommission: Per separately submitted risk-unit order, same as legacy model
execution.price: Observed first trade plus adverse slippage, rounded against trader to tick; modelled impact is not a verified historical fill
execution.capacity: Primary model has no claim to auction depth. Sensitivity caps fills by 1% of lagged 20-session average volume; no future volume in sizing
execution.exposureCap: Applies to purchases after costs, not forced rebalancing; drift may exceed 50%
execution.terminal: Mark open positions to last raw close and accrued ex-date dividend; no forced terminal sale

validation.historicalHoldoutLabel: Retrospective temporal holdout; NOT genuine unseen data because these rules were developed after these dates
validation.freeze: Protocol saved before inspecting new four-market account returns. No optimization or best-parameter selection.

benchmarks.passive: Same ETF, same sessions, fees, slippage, dividend/split treatment; dividends kept in cash
benchmarks.exposureMatch: Solve initial passive weight to match full-sample average exposure; ex-post diagnostic only
benchmarks.riskMatch: Solve initial passive weight to match full-sample realized daily volatility, without leverage; ex-post diagnostic only
benchmarks.holdout: Weights fitted on data ending 2023-12-31 only and carried unchanged into a fresh 2024+ account
